reviews.author: Mount Calvary Baptist Church
reviews.text: Had part of a neighbor's tree fall on the corner of my house this morning at 7 am. I called Rodney's though I had never done business with him before. He and his crew were at my house by a little after 10 (they don't open until 9) and they had taken care of everything before noon. They did a fantastic job, cleaning up all the limbs and debris all for a reasonable price. I highly recommend them to you if you're in need of a tree service! ~Pastor Bob Benson

reviews.author: LaTonya A
reviews.text: We had a few trees super close to our home and the neighbor's so naturally concerned about who to trust removing them. With Mr Rodney's years of experience and a neighbor's referral we took a chance. Him and his crew did an amazing job. In addition, Mr. Rodney and his wife Ms Phyllis are super kind and understanding people. They understood the deadline I needed to make so very accommodating. With their reasonable prices I then hired them for a much bigger job. They did not disappoint. We are now able to enjoy more of our property.

reviews.author: Charlie Pearce
reviews.text: Highly recommend Rodney’s Tree Service Clayton NC. Mr Rodney, his wife and employees were outstanding helping us a remove large Oak Tree that was too close to our fence. They were honest, prompt and were competently professional! Couldn’t ask for a better job. They expertly downed the tree, ground up the stump and cleaned up to where you cannot even see where the original tree stood. They are a Godsend. If you ever need this kind of help, please give Rodney’s Tree Service a call !

reviews.author: Bobby Gardner
reviews.text: I have used Rodney's Tree Service several times to have trees and stumps removed at my home. They have always done a great job, were professional in interacting with me and provided a great price for their services. I would recommend Rodney, Phyliss and their team if you are looking to have trees or stumps removed from your property.
